name: sanity
description: The slide into madness: a gradual, scarier-than-a-drug-trip dread that escalates as sanity falls — a creeping cold vignette + dread bed + misperception whispers (25–49), room-filling phantom hallucinations (below 25, via the shared phantom registry), and an incapacitated 'insane' state at 0 that the engine's substrate gate reads to scramble commands.
